messages:
tess: Noticing spikes of duplicate sessions from mobile clients via cdn-us-west-1. Pattern: CDN issues TCP RST on idle, client reconnects immediately -> full init sent -> double sessions billed.

omar: RST shows up as ws.onclose 1006, so client can't resume. Any raw logs?

lee: Log snippet:
```
cdn-usw1 | conn=0x9a idle=95s action=terminate type=RST
proxy    | downstream recv RST conn=0x9a
server   | init token=rt_fff seen -> new session created
```

omar: Short term: accept duplicate resume-token on init for N seconds and emit metric stream.reconnect.rst. Long term: tweak CDN idle or keepalive.

tess: Agreed. Add a console filter to hide soft reconnects from customer session counts. Also need alert: stream.reconnect.rst > 30/min by region.

lee: Will implement soft-accept window=45s, send header X-Resume-Attached when we reattach. Canary to us-west-1.

ops-bot: Deployment started: lee/soft-attach -> canary us-west-1.

lee: (5m) Canary shows reconnect.rst metric spike on canary nodes; new-session count for affected clients down ~70%, no CPU/memory impact.

omar: Good. Follow-ups: (1) Grafana panel and alert (omar) (2) Console session filter ticket (tess) (3) RFC on soft-attach / seq reconciliation (lee).

tess: Drafting runbook: how to tell RST vs FIN, where to correlate cdn-edge id, rollback steps.

lee: RFC draft: https://go/redwood/rfc/soft-attach - recommends default window=45s and graceful degrade to full init if seq mismatch >50.

omar: Thanks. Promote after 30m stable. Closing thread when full roll finishes.
